tactics.name: A grandchild in trouble
red_flags: A courier who picks up money at your home
tactics.safe_step: Hang up. Call your grandchild or a parent on a number you already have. Police never collect cash bail.

tactics.name: A bank "investigator"
tactics.arrives_by: Phone call or text about "suspicious activity"
red_flags: Asks you to withdraw cash or buy gift cards
Asks you to hand over your card
tactics.safe_step: Hang up. Call the number on the back of your card.

tactics.name: A government refund or benefit
red_flags: A refund or benefit that is "waiting"
tactics.safe_step: Don't click. Check your CRA My Account by typing the address yourself. The CRA never sends e-transfers.

tactics.name: A parcel delivery fee
tactics.safe_step: Delete it. Track parcels only in the seller's own app or website.

tactics.name: An unpaid toll or fine
red_flags: A threat about your licence or credit
tactics.safe_step: Sign in to the real account by typing the address yourself. Never pay from a text link.

tactics.name: A tech-support warning
red_flags: A red alarm screen and a countdown
A request to let them connect to your device
tactics.safe_step: Close the browser, or restart the device if it won't close. Never call the number shown.

tactics.name: A famous face in an investment ad
tactics.safe_step: Don't click. Check any program on canada.ca and any firm with your securities regulator.

tactics.name: An online romance
tactics.safe_step: Talk to someone you trust before you send anything. Reverse-search the photos.

tactics.name: A fake kidnapping call
tactics.safe_step: Hang up if you can. Reach the person another way. Call 911 if you're worried.

tactics.name: A fake fraud-recovery offer
red_flags: Offers to get your lost money back for a fee
tactics.safe_step: Hang up. The CAFC never asks for money.

tactics.name: A genuine message
tactics.arrives_by: Text, call or email from someone or somewhere you know
red_flags: No payment or personal details asked for
tactics.safe_step: Reply as you normally would, or call the number you already have if you're unsure.
